warnings.message: spec.json is deliberately absent. The two-arm terminal binding and final SOURCE_ONLY launch review are still pending. This PREPARED_SOURCE_ONLY report, even after fixes, cannot satisfy launch_probe_authorized.py:14.

No model/GPU replay, terminal weight load, remote resource check, installation, training change or retention was performed. Python 3.7 grammar checking on local Python 3.12 and prior NumPy recount do not establish execution in the target Python 3.7/Torch 1.10.2 runtime.

The verified 64 reference rows have only native GT slot 0. This augmented training cohort contains correlated candidates and cannot establish unseen-scene accuracy, nonempty multi-GT protection, physical-instance identity, or a new formal selection rule.

Qualification deliberately uses saved parent GPU Box IoU and integer Query/fused Mask counts. CPU float64 IoUs drive paired metrics and report threshold disagreements. GPU DFL scalars are retained and explicitly not independently recomputed on CPU; cached head equality is not a cross-CUDA complete-forward identity claim.

checks.name: prepare_closed_spec_guards
checks.details: Requires the real fit observer closed, controller absent, zero exit, complete status and all four train/formal runs; both 3723-update/29778-row training receipts, both 9508-row formal receipts, terminal/restore SHA agreement, zero train/formal exits and completed intake must exist before spec creation. The current single closed control receipt is not substituted for a closed pair.

checks.name: launch_gate
checks.details: Launcher requires a later SOURCE_REVIEW.json with execution_scope SOURCE_ONLY and unchanged reviewed files, actual spec, remote complete paired status/zero exit, idle GPU and resource lock. Current PREPARED_SOURCE_ONLY report and absent spec are not launch approval.

checks.name: cached_head_comparison
checks.details: One complete parent forward per batch captures the same Query, raw points, coarse boxes and mutable output dictionary. Three replays replace exactly all 10 geometry state tensors/456102 parameters. The inspected refiner dependencies read the frozen upstream inputs and masks, do not update them, and have no dropout/BatchNorm behavior in this head. The parent replay must equal parent final boxes. Scores and Mask tensors are checked unchanged; no optimizer, backward, parameter update or checkpoint writer is present.

checks.name: fixed_parent_qualification
checks.details: Matching is captured once from the parent native final layer (the existing verified matches[1] convention). Every matched query is marked by its valid native GT slot and excluded. Qualification uses own Query Mask IoU>.5 AND fused Mask IoU>.5 AND parent final Box IoU<=.5 AND unmatched. It is computed from retained parent outputs regardless of either trained arm's subsequent IoU.

checks.name: GT_and_integer_mask_evidence
checks.details: Targets are actual dataset root boxes/masks, never another model's output. Superpoint member/root-member counts and binary selected masks produce integer point intersections/unions saved as int64. TF32 is disabled and the 50000-point count range is exactly representable in float32. CPU qualification uses 2*intersection>union without a float Mask threshold. Existing saved count dtypes were verified integer.

checks.name: CPU_paired_metrics_and_DFL_definition
checks.details: CPU float64 axis-aligned box IoU and face errors/moves are recomputed from saved boxes. Fixed groups and pairwise strict .25/.5 repairs/damages are correct, including exact-threshold equality. DFL follows the same nonuniform knots, clipping, interpolation and six-face mean as distribution_loss. Range groups use the common coarse-parent face targets.

checks.name: model_state_restoration
checks.details: The runner restores the parent head, checks every model.state_dict entry against the original CPU clone and requires all gradients absent. Both controller and analysis now require the produced model_state_restored field. The source generator preserves that corrected contract.

checks.name: honest_scope_and_retention_order
checks.details: The plan/records label preparation and old-data metric checking as non-accuracy evidence. No retention is invoked in this packet. After real pair closure and final source refresh, the actual cohort probe/intake/CPU audit must complete while both terminal heads still exist and before external retention deletes a nonbest head.

checks.name: exit_file_contract
checks.details: The controller writes probe.exit, collection preserves its basename, and CPU analysis requires complete/probe.exit with exit code zero. controller.exit remains a separate required zero-exit check.

validation.prior_round_checks_reused: The earlier read-only NPZ/paired-metric/reference-identity checks remain valid because all corresponding code and evidence hashes are unchanged. They were not rerun in this refresh.

next_required_action: After the actual full paired fit/formal run closes and its text results are collected, bind the real terminal metadata with prepare_closed_spec.py and perform the separate final SOURCE_ONLY review before GPU launch. Complete the actual cohort/intake/CPU audit while both terminal heads still exist and before nonbest-head retention.

resolved_findings.details: controller.py:39 now requires model_state_restored, the exact field produced after complete model-state restoration. prepare_probe.py:26-27 applies the same change when regenerating the controller. Byte reversal of this one field and the two generator lines reproduces the initial source hashes.
analyze_probe.py:20 now requires complete/probe.exit, matching controller.py:32 and collection's preserved basename. Byte reversal of this one filename reproduces the initial source hash.
